name: starter-p2-reefer-otr-two-years
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-reefer-otr-two-years brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

details: Produce out of the valley to the Midwest

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Pay runs $0.70 to $0.78 per mile on reefer freight, over the road. You haul produce out of the valley to the Midwest. 401k and a rider policy. Class A, 23+. Apply today.
en.headline: 401k and a rider policy

es.primary_text: Pagamos de $0.70 a $0.78 por milla en carga refrigerada, OTR. Llevas producto del valle al Medio Oeste. 401k y se permite pasajero. Licencia Clase A, mayores de 23. Aplica hoy.
es.headline: 401k y pasajero permitido

en.primary_text: Out 2 weeks, home 4 days. That is how this reefer run goes. $0.70 to $0.78 per mile, and a rider policy so you can bring a passenger. Class A, 23+.
en.headline: Out 2 weeks, home 4 days

es.primary_text: 2 semanas en ruta, 4 días en casa. Así va esta ruta de reefer. De $0.70 a $0.78 por milla y se permite pasajero. Licencia Clase A, mayores de 23.

en.primary_text: Load produce out of the valley and run it to the Midwest in a reefer. Over the road, out 2 weeks and home 4 days. $0.70 to $0.78 per mile, plus 401k. Class A, 23+.
